236:t_1:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...My anger, hatred, sadness... Everything is melting together... like pure, clear water...」

236:t_1:10.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...This is... the meaning... of $$アクエリオン$$...」

236:t_1:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「No...! $$ララァ$$'s soul isn't in a place like this...!」

236:t_1:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$... And everyone else, too...」

236:t_1:19.en:
$$刹那$$
「I don't know... We were... caught in a $$時空震動$$...」

236:t_1:20.en:
$$シン$$
「But our ships and machines are gone. We're here in the flesh...」

236:t_1:22.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It feels like when $$ニュータイプ$$s resonate with each other, but...」

236:t_1:23.en:
$$刹那$$
「Yes... It's also like a space filled with $$ＧＮ粒子$$...」

236:t_1:24.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Then why am I here instead of $$ティファ$$...?!」

236:t_1:25.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If that's the case, what about me...?」

236:t_1:26.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What everyone here has in common is...」

236:t_1:27.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Could it be... $$ガンダム$$...?」

236:t_1:30.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We... acquired civilization... And then we acquired tools... $$ガンダム$$s...」

236:t_1:31.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ガンダム$$s... are born in war and burn the world. Amid all that, we... keep moving forward, committing countless sins...」

236:t_1:32.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Pull yourself together, Captain $$アムロ$$!」

236:t_1:33.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is Captain $$アムロ$$ the only one who senses something...?」

236:t_1:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「As they engulf the world in flames, people... evolve... That is... the civilization... of fire...」

236:t_1:36.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's what the $$プロトカルチャー$$ in the ruins said!」

236:t_1:37.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ガンダム$$s are... the civilization of fire...」

236:t_1:38.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And that leads to the sun's radiance, as humanity goes beyond evolution, toward $$シンカ$$...」

237:t_000:1.en:
$$メラン$$
「It seems... we've been transported by another $$時空震動$$.」

237:t_000:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The navigation system's position sensor still indicates the galactic center!」

237:t_000:4.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「I've confirmed all our ships are intact! But I can't locate the $$バトル７$$ or establish communications!」

237:t_000:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All $c units are aboard our ships.」

237:t_000:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So everyone who was there was transported together...」

237:t_000:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「B-But the galactic center may have been far from Earth, yet it was still the universe we knew!」

237:t_000:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「But this place is clearly different...! Where on earth are we...?!」

237:t_000:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...A world we don't know... Is it... another parallel world...?」

237:t_000:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Have you found something, $$ミレイナ$$?」

237:t_000:14.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Oh... Well... I just thought... it was beautiful.」

237:t_000:15.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「...It sure is. This must be an unknown world, but even I can't help staring at it.」

237:t_000:17.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I've spent a good deal of time in space and seen all sorts of stars and nebulae. I feel the same way.」

237:t_000:18.en:
$$ボビー$$
「If we weren't in this situation, we could just enjoy the view...」

237:t_000:19.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$フェルト$$... Has the position sensor stopped working?」

237:t_000:20.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Well... there's something a little strange about it.」

237:t_000:22.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Our present coordinates indicate the galactic center... The exact center, in fact.」

237:t_000:23.en:
$$メラン$$
「So this is a different sector from the area around Planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$, where we were.」

237:t_000:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Were we... simply transported to the center of the galaxy we were in?」

237:t_000:26.en:
$$オットー$$
「What's wrong, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

237:t_000:27.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Even comparing it with our galactic star charts, this is surely a different place from the universe we know...」

237:t_000:28.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But I cannot say for certain that this isn't the central point of the galaxy.」

237:t_000:30.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We don't really know what conditions are like at the exact center of the galaxy.」

237:t_000:31.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You mean it's unexplored territory...?」

237:t_000:32.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「More than that, distortions in the dimensional boundary and other factors make even observations difficult...」

237:t_000:33.en:
$$オットー$$
「Doesn't that only apply to the world you came from, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

237:t_000:34.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No... I've heard similar accounts myself.」

237:t_000:35.en:
$$メラン$$
「So have I. And that applies to the $$宇宙世紀$$ world I came from as well as $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

237:t_000:36.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So the galaxy's central point is shrouded in mystery in every parallel world we know.」

237:t_000:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...An important consideration: the $$人類銀河同盟$$ possesses information on that subject.」

237:t_000:38.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. I'd like you to disclose that information. Would that be all right?」

237:t_000:39.en:
$$レド$$
「That's fine. ...$$チェインバー#pilot$$, I authorize it.」
